description: Start instant checkout for one listing. Requires sign-in with buyer purchase access. buyer_email is required. quantity must be a positive integer below the listing's quote threshold (quote_quantity_threshold from get_product_details). A threshold of 1 means no quantity can be bought instantly — use request_quote. The listing must have instant checkout and a shipping price. This creates a checkout session; it does not charge the card.
name: quick_buy
title: Quick buy
